title: After calling the message request method of defaultmqproducer, the response data failed due to channel unregister
body:
调用 DefaultMQProducer 的 Message request(final Message msg, final long timeout) 方法后管道注销导致响应数据失败
生产端报错如下：
```java
17:13:52.753 [pool-9-thread-2] ERROR o.h.b.c.session.ActiveSessionCenter   CODE: 10006  DESC: send request message to 
<SETTING> OK, but wait reply message timeout, 10000 ms.; nested exception is 
org.apache.rocketmq.client.exception.RequestTimeoutException: CODE: 10006  DESC: send request message to <SETTING> OK,
 but wait reply message timeout, 10000 ms.; nested exception is org.springframework.messaging.MessagingException: CODE: 
10006  DESC: send request message to <SETTING> OK, but wait reply message timeout, 10000 ms.; nested exception is 
org.apache.rocketmq.client.exception.RequestTimeoutException: CODE: 10006  DESC: send request message to <SETTING> OK, 
but wait reply message timeout, 10000 ms.
```
消费端报错如下：
```java
21:14:17.347 ERROR [NettyClientPublicExecutor_4] o.a.r.s.s.DefaultRocketMQListenerContainer  --  Consumer replies message 
failed. error: CODE: 1  DESC: push reply message to 172.17.0.1@bisRocketMqTemplatefail.,
For more information, please visit the url, http://rocketmq.apache.org/docs/faq/,
```
